title: PRD-04 synthetic risk input syntax

locationRef.description: required; authorized address with jurisdiction precision. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: LOCATION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

occupancyCode.description: required; versioned residential/commercial use code. Sensitivity: internal. Error: OCCUPANCY_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

constructionCode.description: required; carrier-mapped construction class. Sensitivity: internal. Error: CONSTRUCTION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

areaM2.description: required; positive, <= 12 digits and 2 decimals. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: AREA_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

buildingValue.description: conditional for building cover; nonnegative; positive if building selected. Sensitivity: financial. Error: BUILDING_VALUE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

contentsValue.description: conditional for contents cover; nonnegative; positive if contents selected. Sensitivity: financial. Error: CONTENTS_VALUE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

perilCodes.description: required; 1–30 unique carrier-offered codes. Sensitivity: internal. Error: PERIL_DEPENDENCY_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
